immutability: An activated policy is sealed and never edited. A later threshold is a new SUFFICIENCY-POLICY-NNN record with supersedes naming its predecessor; the old policy, the old evidence, and the old evaluation are preserved, and a threshold change never silently reclassifies historical evidence.
note: An ACTIVE policy requires every dimension explicitly decided (no nulls), an artifact_digest binding it to exact bytes, and an authority who is an assigned AUTH-ALPHA-PROGRAM identity. The Phase 12 committed policy (qualification/phase12/sufficiency-policy.json, all thresholds null) remains the Phase 12 evaluation authority and is untouched by this registry.
purpose: The owner-controlled Alpha sufficiency threshold registry. Zero policies means THRESHOLDS_UNDEFINED: the registry state is SUFFICIENCY_POLICY_UNDEFINED, every evaluation is SUFFICIENCY_UNDETERMINED, and no quantity of evidence becomes SUFFICIENT. No production value is invented here - null is not a threshold and a default is not a decision.
